morse.itu-phonetic-alphabet-spell: ITU phonetic alphabet · spell callsigns on phone
morse.koch-method-recognise-characters: Koch method: recognise characters at the target speed (18 WPM or more recommended). Start with 2 characters; once you reach 90% accuracy at a level the next character is added automatically, and the newest and most-missed characters appear more often. When the effective speed is below the character speed, Farnsworth spacing kicks in: characters stay fast and only the gaps between characters and groups get longer.
morse.invitation-to-a-specific: Invitation to a specific station only

morse.after-copying-the-callsign: After copying the callsign press Enter to jump to the serial, then Enter to log; a correct callsign scores 2 and a correct serial adds 1.
morse.hold-the-microphone-near: Hold the microphone near the rig speaker to auto-detect the speed and decode in real time.

morse.digit-pronunciation-0-zero: Digit pronunciation: 0 Zero · 1 One · … · 9 Niner. Phonetic playback uses the system TTS (English voice pack); Morse is synthesised with Web Audio and the speed can be adjusted above.
